territories.name: Nasca Namrium Ulmeria United Eastern Empire
territories.boundarySource: Sources of Truth/Source Map/Base Map - Blue.png (drawn border lines, traced)
territories.notes: Labelled 'Eastern Empire' (capital Nasca) on the territories reference map.

control.basis: Before the mobilization order the Empire is not yet at war.
Imperial mobilization ordered (EVT-0001).
Combat ends when Michael and Feldway withdraw (EVT-0386). There was no imperial armistice proposal: Benimaru demanded unconditional surrender, which the Empire accepts at the summit (EVT-0392).

territories.name: Jura Tempest Federation
territories.boundarySource: Sources of Truth/Source Map/Base Map - Blue.png (drawn border lines, traced)
territories.notes: Labelled 'Jura-Tempest Federation' (capital Rimuru). The Great Jura Forest lies inside this region.

control.basis: No war footing recorded before the Control Room order of battle.
Tempest confirms its four-corps order of battle against the coming invasion (EVT-0004).
Combat ends with the withdrawal of Michael and Feldway (EVT-0386).

control.basis: Dwargon is not attacked before the blockade of its eastern gate.
The Empire blockades Dwargon's eastern gate (EVT-0016); the allied division of tasks follows (EVT-0018).
Fighting on the Dwargon front ends when the clowns are withdrawn (EVT-0385) and combat ends with the withdrawal (EVT-0386).
